NextcloudSSO.PluginDescription: Single Sign-On (SSO) authentication for Matomo via Nextcloud OIDC / OAuth2.
NextcloudSSO.SettingNextcloudUrlHelp: Full URL of your Nextcloud instance (e.g. https://cloud.example.com).
NextcloudSSO.SettingProviderTypeHelp: Select 'OIDC Identity Provider' (recommended) or Nextcloud built-in OAuth2.
NextcloudSSO.SettingClientIdHelp: The Client ID generated in Nextcloud for Matomo.
NextcloudSSO.SettingClientSecretHelp: The Client Secret generated in Nextcloud.
NextcloudSSO.SettingScopeHelp: Requested scopes, space separated (Default: 'openid profile email groups').
NextcloudSSO.SettingAuthorizeUrlHelp: Leave empty to automatically derive the authorization URL from the Base URL.
NextcloudSSO.SettingTokenUrlHelp: Leave empty to automatically derive the token endpoint URL from the Base URL.
NextcloudSSO.SettingUserinfoUrlHelp: Leave empty to automatically derive the userinfo endpoint URL from the Base URL.
NextcloudSSO.SettingAutoCreateUserHelp: When enabled, a Matomo account is automatically created upon first successful Nextcloud login.
NextcloudSSO.SettingSyncUserInfo: Sync user profile on every login
NextcloudSSO.SettingSyncUserInfoHelp: Updates email address and display name upon every login from Nextcloud.
NextcloudSSO.SettingAdminGroupHelp: Nextcloud group whose members automatically receive full SuperUser access in Matomo (Default: 'admin').
NextcloudSSO.SettingDefaultRoleHelp: Permission level granted to non-admin users upon automatic account creation.
NextcloudSSO.RoleNoAccess: No direct access (must be manually granted)
NextcloudSSO.SettingDefaultSitesHelp: Enter 'all' for all websites or a comma-separated list of site IDs (e.g. 1, 2, 5).
NextcloudSSO.SettingButtonTextHelp: Text displayed on the SSO login button (e.g. 'Sign in with Nextcloud').
NextcloudSSO.SettingAutoRedirectHelp: Instantly redirects visitors of the login page to Nextcloud SSO (local login remains accessible via ?local=1).
NextcloudSSO.SettingAllowLocalLoginHelp: Keeps the regular username/password form visible below the SSO button.
NextcloudSSO.ErrorNotConfigured: The Nextcloud SSO plugin is not yet configured. Please specify Nextcloud URL, Client ID, and Secret in system settings.
NextcloudSSO.ErrorStateMismatch: Security error: The OAuth state parameter does not match (potential CSRF attempt). Please try again.
NextcloudSSO.ErrorCodeMissing: No authorization code was returned by Nextcloud.
NextcloudSSO.ErrorInvalidResponse: Invalid response received from Nextcloud server.
NextcloudSSO.ErrorNoUserId: Could not extract a unique user identifier from Nextcloud profile.
NextcloudSSO.ErrorUserNotFoundNoSignup: No Matomo account exists for this Nextcloud user and automatic signup is disabled. Please contact your administrator.
NextcloudSSO.ErrorHttpRequestFailed: Network error while communicating with Nextcloud server
